metadata.description: Narrated explainer videos for code and papers, routed across Remotion, Manim, Archify, and HyperFrames

plugins.name: visualize-anything
plugins.description: Router skill that turns code or a paper into a narrated explainer video: edge-tts narration, an opening animated in Manim, and each scene routed to the picture that explains it (code beside its animation, a Manim scene composed from a kit of ready-made pictures, an Archify diagram, or the source's own numbers, charts, quotes, and figures), composed with Remotion.
